notes.zh: 审阅注：first_contact.1 是 base_contact_set 对普通国家发出的“遭遇”事件；唯一选项调用 set_first_contact_starting_stage，对普通国家进入 default_stage_1。
notes.en: Review note: first_contact.1 is what base_contact_set fires for ordinary countries; its only option calls set_first_contact_starting_stage, which puts default empires in default_stage_1.

notes.zh: 审阅注：第一阶段的每个事件有两类选项：攻击（需“允许攻击”政策且能看到对方飞船，进入敌对阶段，见 event-first-contact-250）；平和选项按双方关系分流——同族 → 101；双方机械 → 102（失落殖民地则 1020）；双方蜂巢 → 105；否则进入第二阶段。
notes.en: Review note: every stage-1 event offers an attack option (needs the attack-allowed policy and sight of their ship; enters the hostile stage, see event-first-contact-250) and a peaceful option routed by relationship — same species → 101, two machines → 102 (1020 for a lost colony), two hives → 105, otherwise stage 2.

notes.zh: 审阅注：50 的选项A/B都进入通用谨慎收尾阶段（→100/103/104）；选项C（仅非主动政策）进入入侵阶段（见 event-first-contact-200）。60 只有一个选项，进入通用主动收尾阶段。
notes.en: Review note: options A and B of 50 both enter the generic cautious end stage (→ 100/103/104); option C (non-proactive only) enters the hacking stage (see event-first-contact-200). 60 has one option, to the generic proactive end stage.

scope.zh: 首次接触主线：遭遇(1)、第一阶段五种开场、第二阶段标准开场(50/60)、同族/机械/蜂巢提前收尾，以及基础集合的特殊替代入口。
scope.en: The main first-contact line: the encounter (1), the five stage-1 openers, the standard stage-2 openers (50/60), the same-species / machine / hive early endings and the special replacement entries of base_contact_set.

uncertain: first_contact.1 到 leviathans.98 的延迟链（龙等特殊接触）属于利维坦篇，保持原样。 / The delayed leviathans.98 follow-up of the special contacts belongs to the leviathan stories and is left as compiled.
